names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 mai, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Mavra de pe Ceahlău».

floruit.note: doxologia.ro: «Aceasta a trăit pe la sfârșitul veacului al XVII-lea». The same page says that the written notices give her no year: a Romanian paterikon of 1888, quoted by Fr Liviu Stan, names her without one, and the page offers only that she may have been a contemporary of others dated 1660.
